subject: Automatic reply: Resolution of Historical Dispossession and Fraud – Great House Farm, Llandough, Vale of Glamorgan
source: Original email in the family's Gmail (read-only export); contact details redacted.
text:
The Senedd has been dissolved, and as a result Jane Hutt is no longer a Member. She is not seeking re-election and so will not be returning following the election.

This email address will no longer be monitored from the 7th April 2026 and no responses will be sent following this date.

If you have an issue you need help with, you can still contact Kanishka Narayan MP ([email redacted] ) or The Vale of Glamorgan Council ([email redacted] ), as appropriate.

Thank you for your understanding.
